name: Planning
description: Collaborative planning: propose, critique, refine, commit.

phases.name: Propose
phases.prompt: Present your plan or approach. Include goals, steps, risks.

phases.name: Analyse
phases.prompt: Evaluate the plan. What's missing? What could go wrong? Suggest alternatives.

phases.name: Refine
phases.prompt: Incorporate feedback. Present the refined plan.

phases.name: Commit
phases.prompt: Final assessment. Do you approve? Any last concerns?
